units: Sifré Deut. 83 אות בשמים … מ׳ בארץ oth (sign) refers to a phenomenon in the heavens, … mofeth to one on earth.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 93a:7">Snh. 93ᵃ</cite> <he>אנשים שנעשה להם מ׳</he> men in whose behalf a miracle was effected. Y. ib. XI, end, 30ᶜ; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Chullin 103b:14">Ḥull. 103ᵇ</cite> <he>מ׳ הדור</he> thou prodigy of the generation!—Pl. <he>מוֹפְתִים</he>, <he>מוֹפְתִין</he>. Tanḥ. Sh’moth 23.
